title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 32. Notes the conclusion of the Court in its annual report on EU agencies for the financial year 2023 (the ‘Court’s report’), that the Court’s audit had similar results as in the previous year (2022), with weaknesses in public procurement procedures having remained the main source of irregular payments; expresses concern over the recurrence of these serious weaknesses, particularly in certain agencies which, as a result, do not appear to be taking the necessary steps or showing the willingness to put an end to a situation that entails significant legal risks;
